network_status.network: Ponte Guastacconcio – interrogazione parlamentare e quadro dei dissesti
network_status.summary_it: Le fonti collegano il dissesto progressivo della pila alle piene ripetute e all'abbassamento dell'alveo, ma il collasso finale avvenne senza una piena discreta contestuale. Non esiste quindi un colmo idrometrico evento-specifico da associare alla rottura.
network_status.summary_en: The sources link progressive pier distress to repeated floods and riverbed lowering, but the final collapse occurred without a concurrent discrete flood. There is therefore no event-specific hydrometric peak to associate with the failure.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
